entries.0b2ec90bf067c0ad: The company is a general metal building materials manufacturer headquartered in Sumida-ku, Tokyo, engaged in the manufacture, sale and construction of architectural hardware and materials. It has six consolidated subsidiaries and one non-consolidated subsidiary, and as of March 31, 2026, it had 383 employees. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.1e1060beadc22219: Designated to the First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange
entries.1f2399c52504499b: This segment consists of four companies, all consolidated subsidiaries: Sanyo Industries Kyushu System Co., Ltd., Sanyo Industries Tohoku System Co., Ltd., Sanyo Industries Hokkaido System Co., Ltd., and Sanyo Industries Tokyo System Co., Ltd. It sells and constructs architectural hardware and materials, and mainly performs floor system construction.
entries.25e84564f3113d93: This is a segment of the parent company itself, which manufactures, sells and constructs architectural hardware and materials, and sells hardware and materials to the system subsidiaries and Other. Its main products are lightweight wall and ceiling substructures, floor systems and aluminum building materials. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,592 million.
entries.466cb149038a751f: The group's business consists of two company-based reportable segments, "SANYO INDUSTRIES" and "System Subsidiaries," and "Other," which is not included in the reportable segments. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥28,956 million.
entries.4736d8c9a9f51d28: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, including Fujioka Airtight Co., Ltd. and Swan Shoji Co., Ltd., both consolidated subsidiaries, which manufacture, sell and construct architectural hardware and materials. Some of its products are purchased from SANYO INDUSTRIES. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥524 million.
